world.title: Inside Iran's hidden oil network in China: Leaked letter details how Tehran bypasses US sanctions
world.summary: A leaked letter reveals Iran's oil network in China, detailing how Tehran circumvents U.S. sanctions. The document outlines Iran's control over oil terminals, stakes in port facilities, and access to storage tanks across various locations in China. This infrastructure enables Iran to maintain the flow of sanctioned crude oil despite ongoing international restrictions.

world.title: Harmeet K Dhillon says she couldn't protest the Sikh hatred she faced when she was with Trump administration; reveals one of the last messages she exchanged with her late husband
world.summary: Harmeet K Dhillon, a former US assistant attorney general, responded to criticism regarding her Sikh prayer at the 2024 Republican National Convention. She stated that during her time in the Trump administration, she felt unable to protest the hatred directed at her due to her religion. Dhillon also shared one of her last messages exchanged with her late husband.

world.title: 'Get ready to go to jail': Amid Nvidia spy scandal, Trump recounts 'situation' involving major AI company leader
world.summary: Nvidia has initiated an independent investigation into allegations involving CEO Jensen Huang and a purported affair with a Chinese spy, linked to former Megaspeed executive Alic. The situation has drawn attention, with former President Trump referencing it during a recent event. The investigation aims to clarify the claims and their potential implications for the company and its leadership.

business.title: 'Get ready to go to jail': Amid Nvidia spy scandal, Trump recounts 'situation' involving major AI company leader
business.summary: Nvidia has initiated an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following allegations of an affair with a Chinese spy. The controversy has drawn attention from former President Donald Trump, who referenced the situation during a recent event. The investigation aims to clarify the claims and their potential implications for the company and its leadership amidst rising concerns over national security.

business.title: FDA suspends license of 105 food businesses including this famous biryani brand; details inside
business.summary: Maharashtra's Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licenses of 105 food businesses, including a well-known biryani brand, following surprise inspections ahead of Diwali. Seven outlets were ordered to close, with three in Pune, two in Amravati, and others across the state. The inspections aimed to ensure food safety and compliance with regulations during the festive season.

business.title: FIIs cut stake in 10 smallcap stocks for 3 consecutive quarters; shares fall up to 70% in CY26
business.summary: Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) reduced their stakes in approximately 235 smallcap stocks over three consecutive quarters: March, June, and September 2026. This trend has led to significant declines in share prices, with over half of these companies reporting negative returns. Notably, nine smallcap stocks experienced sharp corrections, with declines ranging from 50% to 70% in calendar year 2026.

technology.title: Entrepreneur loses 55 kg in 2 years: Expert shares weight loss tips
technology.summary: Entrepreneur Pavitra Sivalingam lost 55 kg over two years, highlighting her journey of discipline and perseverance. Dietitian Garima Goyal emphasized that weight loss should be evaluated beyond scale numbers, focusing on nutrition, body composition, and health. She recommended a balanced diet, cardiovascular activity, and resistance training, while warning against extreme calorie restriction and the importance of individualized weight-loss goals.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 is available at a lower price: Details here
technology.summary: The Samsung Galaxy S26 is now available at a discounted price of Rs 87,999 on Amazon, down from its retail price of Rs 1,02,999. This reduction makes the smartphone an attractive option for consumers seeking a flagship experience without a high cost. The discount highlights the device's appeal in the competitive smartphone market.

technology.title: Data Manager In Google Analytics
technology.summary: Google has introduced Data Manager in Google Analytics, a centralized tool for managing data streams and connected products from a single interface. This feature allows users to visualize data connections and their status, establishing clear links between data sources and their usage. The aim is to enhance data management efficiency and improve user experience within the platform.

sports.title: Patterson-White wins maiden England call in Test squad for South Africa
sports.summary: Nottinghamshire allrounder Liam Patterson-White has received his first call-up to the England Test squad for the upcoming series against South Africa. He was selected over fellow players Shoaib Bashir and Rehan Ahmed. The announcement highlights the team's strategic decisions as they prepare for the matches, with discussions ongoing regarding the final playing XI.

sports.title: Jemimah Rodrigues back for South Africa ODIs, T20Is
sports.summary: India's cricket team will see the return of star batter Jemimah Rodrigues for the upcoming series against South Africa, which includes one Test, three ODIs, and three T20Is. Additionally, Pratika Rawal will rejoin the squad for the Test after missing the historic match at Lord's against England in July due to prior commitments.

sports.title: Jemimah Rodrigues back for South Africa ODIs, T20Is
sports.summary: India's cricket team will see the return of star batter Jemimah Rodrigues for the upcoming tour of South Africa, which includes one Test, three ODIs, and three T20Is. Additionally, Pratika Rawal will also rejoin the squad for the Test match after missing the historic fixture at Lord's against England in July due to injury.

health.title: Could Menopause Hormone Therapy Help Protect Women's Brains?
health.summary: A Swedish study involving 352 women suggests that hormone therapy may be linked to healthier brain vessels in older age. While the research indicates a potential connection between hormone treatments and brain health, it does not establish causation or confirm that these hormones provide protective benefits. The findings highlight the long-term effects of hormone history on brain health.

health.title: WHO says nearly 4 in 10 cancer cases could be prevented and much of it comes down to lifestyle, infections, air pollution
health.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) reports that nearly 40% of cancer cases could be prevented through current knowledge and actions. In 2024, cancer caused nearly 10 million deaths, highlighting the urgency for preventive measures. Key factors include lifestyle choices, infections, and air pollution. The WHO emphasizes the importance of immediate action to reduce avoidable cancer cases.

health.title: UK backs five health tech research hubs with more than £52m
health.summary: The UK government is allocating over £52 million to five health tech research hubs to advance AI tools aimed at earlier diagnosis and providing care closer to home. This funding, sourced from UK Research and Innovation (UKRI), is intended to support the development of technologies that enhance healthcare delivery and improve patient outcomes across the nation.

science.title: Soil, atmosphere, temperature could interact to make heatwaves more extreme, study finds
science.summary: A recent study has revealed a natural process contributing to extreme heatwaves in mid-latitudes, particularly in northwestern India. It highlights the interaction between soil moisture, atmospheric pressure, and temperature, which collectively lead to increased temperatures. Researchers emphasize that understanding this process is crucial for predicting and managing the impacts of future heatwaves on the environment and human health.

science.title: Asteroid KY26 baffles astronomers as it is found too warm to be a comet
science.summary: Asteroid 1998 KY26 is exhibiting unusual movement, leading astronomers to question its classification. While it may resemble a comet, its temperature is too high to retain ice, suggesting it cannot be a dark comet. A recent study published in Icarus explores these anomalies, leaving researchers puzzled about the true nature of this celestial object.

science.title: Integrative meta-transcriptomics and machine learning reveal defence networks and regulatory hubs in response to tomato bacterial pathogens
science.summary: A study on tomato (Solanum lycopersicum) defense against bacterial pathogens utilized integrative meta-transcriptomics and machine learning. Researchers identified 178 upregulated and 177 downregulated consensus DEGs, revealing complex hormonal networks and metabolic reprogramming. Key genes linked to proline metabolism and redox homeostasis were highlighted. This framework aids in prioritizing candidate genes for future studies on tomato defense responses.

entertainment.title: Anil Kapoor reveals how he reinvents himself
entertainment.summary: Veteran actor Anil Kapoor, currently hosting _India Ke Top 1%_, highlights the necessity of stepping outside his comfort zone to stay relevant in the industry after four decades. He believes in avoiding repetitive formulas, citing his introduction of the show 24 to Indian television and his hosting role as examples of embracing new opportunities and challenges.

entertainment.title: 'Nitesh Sir Wanted Fire In My Eyes': Raghav Juyal On Playing Meghnad In Ramayana
entertainment.summary: Raghav Juyal expressed excitement about his role as Meghnad in Ramayana Part 2, stating that director Nitesh Tiwari wanted "fire in my eyes" for the character. Although he did not reveal many details about his performance, fans are curious about his special appearance, especially following Sunny Deol's portrayal of Hanuman in the previous installment, which was well-received.

entertainment.title: 'Ranabaali' OTT release: Where and when to watch Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's period drama online
entertainment.summary: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna’s period drama 'Ranabaali' will be available for streaming on an OTT platform starting November 13. This release comes just weeks after its theatrical debut. The announcement was made on November 9, allowing audiences to watch the film from the comfort of their homes. Details about the streaming platform have not been specified.
